summary: Verified WhatsApp/OG link preview meta tag fixes on SANATÖLYE preview site. All OG + Twitter meta tags present in static HTML (not JS-injected), og-image.jpg served with HTTP 200 image/jpeg (56934 bytes), favicon 200, title contains SANATÖLYE, page renders Hero + WhatsApp button with no console errors. og:url and og:image correctly point to production domain (https://harmony-portal-11.emergent.host) as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: public/index.html correctly declares og:type=website, og:image 1200x630 with secure_url and image/jpeg mime, twitter:card=summary_large_image — meets WhatsApp/Twitter/FB scraper requirements.

og:image and og:url are hardcoded to production host (https://harmony-portal-11.emergent.host) — this is intentional per request, but means preview-domain shares would still show production URL/image (acceptable trade-off).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only static site. All 5 acceptance criteria from the bug fix request verified: (1) OG + Twitter meta tags present in raw HTML via curl, (2) og:image/twitter:image = https://harmony-portal-11.emergent.host/og-image.jpg, og:url = https://harmony-portal-11.emergent.host/, (3) GET /og-image.jpg → 200 image/jpeg 56934 bytes, (4) page loads with no console errors, Hero + WhatsApp button (wa.me/905320000000) visible, (5) <title> contains SANATÖLYE and /sanatolye_emblem.png favicon returns 200. No regressions.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix verification only. Original bug (missing WhatsApp link preview) was caused by absent OG meta tags. Fix in public/index.html adds full OG + Twitter Card meta set plus a 1200x630 og-image.jpg in public/ — verified working.
